title: Swiss-style jazz poster series
summary: A poster series for an invented jazz festival built on a strict 6-column grid, condensed grotesque type and a single saffron accent over ink and paper tones. The process slides show the grid, the type scale and a grain overlay.

key_points.text: A 6-column grid sets every element's edge.
One accent colour carries the whole series.

look: Ink, paper and saffron; condensed type; heavy grain
